mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invitation (email, project_id, invite_type, token_hash, status, invited_by, expires_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{projectId}, #{inviteType}, #{tokenHash}, 'pending', #{invitedBy}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE invitation SET status = 'accepted', accepted_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE invitation SET status = 'expired' WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND lower(email) = lower(#{email}) AND invite_type = #{inviteType} AND status = 'pending'
